items.title: The Provenance-First Wiki: Why the LLM Wiki Pattern Breaks Past a Thousand Files, and the Five Invariants That Fix It
items.description: (GitHub) - A preprint analyzing scaling failures in the LLM Wiki pattern once vaults exceed 1,000 files, caused by index bloat and self-referential loops. Proposes the "Provenance-First" model where quotes are pointers to immutable source documents, and defines five invariants and a falsification protocol to enforce data integrity.

repo_info.description: Why the LLM Wiki pattern breaks past 1,000 files, and the five invariants that fix it. A quote is a pointer, not a copy. Paper + full decision record. Free to read noncommercially with attribution; commercial use licensed.
